comment: eat.c eataccessory() changes an attribute through attrib.c adjattrib(), which prints its You_feel() message and, for Strength, calls pickup.c encumber_msg(). A human Samurai in debug mode (fixed starting inventory, so the wishes land on f and g) wishes for an uncursed +2 ring of adornment and an uncursed -3 ring of gain strength, polymorphs into a xorn, and eats both: 'You feel very charismatic!' and 'You feel very weak!'. The seed is the first of 7310001-7310400 where both rings are metallic and both meals pass rn2(3) (port scan; 4 of 400 did).
